name: TrueWood Lite Grey Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Solid rubberwood slats wrapped in real grey oak veneer on three sides, stapled to a black acoustic felt backing.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet dimensions override photo estimates and rounded inch figures: 8 slats, each 27 mm (1.063 in) wide with 10.5 mm (0.413 in) gaps, on a 37.5 mm (1.476 in) pitch; the tile covers the 300 mm installed panel width by 600 mm tall, with 5 mm slats on 5 mm felt (10 mm total depth). Grey oak face colors are sampled from the main listing photo, with synthesized wrapping veneer grain and black felt; the 305 mm overall panel width includes the overlapping joint and is not the installed repeat.
